text: ​Great app! Suggestion on target calculation ​Love the clean design! A small logic issue: for habits meant for workdays only (e.g. 2 mins Mon-Fri), setting frequency to "Every day" forces the weekly target to 12/14 mins, even if the reminder is set to "Workdays only". ​Feature Request: Please allow setting active days (e.g. Mon-Fri) in "Frequency", so the weekly target calculates correctly as 10 mins instead of forcing 7 days. Thanks!
